user.title: HeatManager
user.description: General settings. Rooms are added afterwards via Configure.

data_description.frost_temp: Used while a window is open and for rooms set to frost protection.
data_description.window_delay: How long a window must be open before the heating is lowered.

data_description.windows: Optional. While any of them is open, the room is set to frost protection.
data_description.temp_sensors: Optional. One or more room sensors. Without any, the thermostats' own readings are used.
data_description.occupancy_sensors: Optional. When all of them have been off for the set time, the room is lowered to the temperature below (only rooms with a profile). Heating resumes as soon as one turns on. Presence sensors (mmWave) suit rooms where people sit still, e.g. bedrooms.
data_description.vacant_delay: How long all sensors must be off before the room counts as empty.
data_description.vacant_temp: Maximum target while the room is empty.

data_description.temp_sensors: Optional. One or more room sensors. Without any, the thermostats' own readings are used.
data_description.occupancy_sensors: Optional. When all of them have been off for the set time, the room is lowered to the temperature below (only rooms with a profile). Heating resumes as soon as one turns on. Presence sensors (mmWave) suit rooms where people sit still, e.g. bedrooms.
data_description.vacant_delay: How long all sensors must be off before the room counts as empty.
data_description.vacant_temp: Maximum target while the room is empty.

data_description.frost_temp: Used while a window is open and for rooms set to frost protection.
data_description.window_delay: How long a window must be open before the heating is lowered.

presence.title: Away & presence
presence.description: Optional. When none of these is at home, rooms with a profile are lowered to the away temperature. Rooms set to Manual stay untouched.

data_description.presence_entities: Persons, device trackers, groups or binary sensors. Leave empty to turn the feature off.
data_description.away_temp: Maximum target while nobody is home.
data_description.away_delay: How long everybody must be gone before lowering.

room_temperature.title: Room temperature of {room}
room_temperature.description: How HeatManager forms the room's actual temperature from its sensors and how the thermostats use it. Sensors that are unavailable or have not reported for longer than the maximum age are ignored; without any valid sensor the thermostats' own readings are used. With several sensors, each gets a weight below (0 = not counted, only used for the upper limit).{weights}

data_description.temp_method: Mean (weighted), lowest, highest, or a main sensor with the others as fallback.
data_description.window_near_sensors: Ignored while a window of the room is open and 15 minutes after it was closed.
data_description.sensor_max_age: A sensor that has not reported for this long counts as failed.
data_description.upper_limit: Stop heating while any sensor is this far above the target (0 = off). Heats again 0.5 K below the limit.
data_description.control: Only 'Thermostat controls itself' leaves the setpoint exactly as planned.

room_external.title: External temperature inputs in {room}
room_external.description:
For each thermostat, the number entity that takes an external room temperature (often called 'External temperature'). HeatManager sends the room temperature there at least every 15 minutes. Thermostats without one are compensated instead.

{thermostats}

error.name_exists: A room with this name already exists.

pause.name: Pause schedule
pause.description: Pause all heating profiles. Thermostats keep their current temperature. Without duration or end, the pause lasts until resumed.

resume.name: Resume schedule
resume.description: End the pause and apply the heating profiles again.

override_room.name: Override room temperature
override_room.description: Hold one room at a temperature for a while, then return to its plan.

room.name: Room
room.description: Name or id of the HeatManager room.

until.name: Until
until.description: When the room returns to its plan.

until_next_change.name: Until next change
until_next_change.description: Hold it until the room's profile changes the temperature next.

clear_room_override.name: End room override
clear_room_override.description: Return the room to its plan now.

room.name: Room
room.description: Name or id of the HeatManager room.

start_vacation.name: Start vacation
start_vacation.description: Frost protection for all rooms with a profile or frost protection until the given moment, then the schedule continues. Manual rooms stay untouched.

thermostat_not_accepting.title: {thermostat} does not take its setpoint
thermostat_not_accepting.description:
HeatManager asked **{thermostat}** (`{entity_id}`, room {room}) four times over about 13 minutes to heat to {temperature} °C, but it keeps reporting a different setpoint.

Check the device: batteries, radio connection, child lock, or an internal schedule/auto mode that overrides commands. The warning disappears as soon as the thermostat takes a setpoint again.

thermostat_unavailable.title: {thermostat} has been unavailable for over an hour
thermostat_unavailable.description:
**{thermostat}** (`{entity_id}`, room {room}) has been unavailable for more than an hour, so HeatManager cannot control it.

Check batteries and the radio connection. The warning disappears as soon as the thermostat is back.

thermostat_not_responding.title: {thermostat} does not respond
thermostat_not_responding.description:
HeatManager sent **{thermostat}** (`{entity_id}`, room {room}) {temperature} °C four times over about 13 minutes, but the device has not reported anything since. Home Assistant may still show its last known values.

The device most likely lost its radio connection or hangs: check batteries and range (e.g. the Zigbee/Thread map), or take the batteries out briefly. Tip for Zigbee2MQTT: enable *availability* so such devices show up as unavailable. The warning disappears as soon as the thermostat takes a setpoint again.

sensors_unavailable.title: No temperature sensor of {room} has reported for over an hour
sensors_unavailable.description:
None of the temperature sensors of room **{room}** ({sensors}) has delivered a valid value for more than an hour. HeatManager uses the thermostats' own readings meanwhile.

Check batteries and the radio connection of the sensors. The warning disappears as soon as one of them reports again.
